（……うーむ。予定もなくて暇だったから、\n街まで出てきたが……何もやる事が思い: (...Hmm. I didn't have any plans and was bored, so I came out to the town... but I can't think of a single thing to do.)
（純夏や委員長達はそれぞれ予定を立てて出かけちまったし……\nまあ、気分転換の散: (Sumika, the Class Rep, and the others all made their own plans and went out... Well, taking a stroll for a change of pace isn't bad either.)
……ん？ 冥夜じゃないか。\nこんな場所で奇遇だな。: ...Hm? Meiya? Fancy meeting you in a place like this.
タケルか。そなたも買いものか？: Takeru. Are you out shopping as well?
いいや、オレは散歩だ。\nまあ、ヒマだったんでな。そっちは？: Nah, I'm just taking a walk. I was bored, mostly. What about you?
私も街を散策していたのだ。: I was strolling through the town myself.
冥夜も目的無しで散歩したりすることがあるんだな。\nちょっと意外だ。: I didn't think you'd be the type to walk around without a purpose, Meiya. That's a bit surprising.
ああ。普段は「自己研鑽を怠ってはならないのだ！」って言って、\nそのまま訓練とか: Yeah. Usually I'd expect you to say, 'We must never neglect our self-improvement!' and go straight into training or something.
たしかに普段の私ならそうしているところだな。: Admittedly, that is usually what I would be doing.
目的はあるぞ。記憶探しだ。: I do have a purpose, however. I am searching for our memories.
我々の戻らない記憶を呼び戻すきっかけがないか……\nそれを探すために街を歩いてい: I was walking through the streets looking for something that might trigger the memories we have yet to recover.
私たちがこちらの世界にやってきて、\n記憶はいまだに戻り切らないであろう？: Since arriving in this world, our memories have still not fully returned, have they?
ああ、そうだな。思い出すにしても、\n関係ない記憶ばっかり思い出して、肝心な部分: Yeah, that's true. Even when we do remember things, it's always random, unrelated stuff. We can't seem to recall the important parts...
そう、肝心なところは出てこないが、\n断片的な記憶が脳裏に過ぎることはある。: Indeed. While the most crucial details remain hidden, fragments of memories occasionally cross my mind.
いずれも大したことではないが……\nそれでも、元の世界の記憶だ。: None of them are of great significance... Yet, they are memories of our original world.
つまり……そんな記憶を思い出すために散歩してるのか？: So... you're walking around hoping to spark those kinds of memories?
ああ。そうして思い出した記憶が、\n我々の帰還を助けるものになるかもしれないと考: Yes. I thought that any memories recovered in this way might aid us in finding a way back.
はは、冥夜らしいな。\nそれなら、オレも記憶探しを手伝ってもいいか？: Haha, spoken like true Meiya. In that case, mind if I help you look for memories too?
よいのか？\nそなたも久々の休みであろう？: Is that acceptable? Is this not a rare day of rest for you as well?
どうせ暇だって時間を持て余してたしな。\nそれに、こういう事は誰かと一緒がいいだ: I had way too much free time on my hands anyway. Besides, stuff like this is always better when you're with someone else, right?
一人で何かをしてた記憶よりも、\n誰かと一緒だった時の記憶の方が良く覚えてるだろ: You're much more likely to recall memories of spending time with someone than doing things all alone.
……なるほど。\nたしかにそなたの言うことも一理あるか。: ...I see. Indeed, there is logic in what you say.
オレにしては冴えてる提案だろ？: Pretty sharp suggestion for me, wouldn't you say?
ふふ……自慢げに言う事でもなかろう。: Fufu... There is no need to sound so proud of it.
ならば……頼んでもよいだろうか？\n私も一人で宛てもなく……少々悩んでいたのだ。: Then... may I accept your help? Truth be told, I was feeling somewhat at a loss wandering around aimlessly by myself.
流石に冥夜もお手上げだったのか。\nそれじゃあ、一緒に行くか。: So even you hit a wall, huh? Alright then, let's head off together.
……そういえばこれはデートなるものなのではないか？: ...Come to think of it, is this what one would call a date?
ん？ 今何か言ったか？: Hm? Did you say something just now?
いいや、なんでもない。では――: No, it was nothing. Well then—
いや、急に腕を組んできたから驚いたんだが。: Well, you suddenly linked your arm with mine, so you caught me off guard.
……その、しっかり思い出したわけではないが……\n遠い記憶に、タケルと一緒に歩い: ...Um, while I have not clearly recalled it... I have a distant memory of walking alongside you like this, Takeru.
その時もこのようにして、\n腕を組んでいたような気がしてな……: I feel as though we were linking arms back then as well...
と、とにかく、そのような気がしたのだ！: A-Anyhow, that was simply the impression I had!
そ、その……タケルが嫌なのであれば、離すが……: I-If... If you dislike it, Takeru, I shall let go...
そうだな。オレもそんな気がしてきた。\nそれじゃ、このまま行こうか。: Now that you mention it, I feel like that happened too. Alright, let's keep going like this.
っ！ あ、ああ！\nでは、このまま行こうではないか！: Ngh! Ah, yes! Let us proceed just as we are, then!
（腕を組んで一緒に歩きたかったのか……\nまあ、たまにはこういうのもいいな）: (She just wanted to walk arm-in-arm together... Well, this kind of thing isn't bad every once in a while.)
歩きにくくはないか？: Is it not difficult to walk like this?
いや、大丈夫だ。\nちょっと恥ずかしいくらいだ。: No, I'm fine. It's just a little embarrassing.
ふふ、確かにな。\n……しかし、何とも平和で良き光景だな。: Fufu, indeed. ...Still, what a remarkably peaceful and pleasant sight.
ああ、そうだな。\nどこか懐かしくて……夢に見たような光景だ。: Yeah, it really is. It feels nostalgic somehow... like a scene I've seen in a dream.
そなたはそう感じるのか？\n私は……どこか知らない別の世界のように感じるが。: Is that how it feels to you? To me... it feels like a completely different, unknown world.
へえ、感じ方が違うのは不思議だな。\nこれもメイズシンドロームとやらの影響か？: Huh, it's strange how we see it differently. Could this also be the influence of that Maze Syndrome stuff?
さて、どうであろうな……\nだが記憶につながるような何かは見当たらないな。: Who can say for certain... However, I have yet to spot anything that might spark a memory.
なら、きっかけになるかもしれないし買い物でもするか？: In that case, want to do some shopping? It might act as a trigger.
ふむ……しかし、買いたいものが浮かばぬな。\n無理をして買ったのならば、それは無: Hmm... Yet, I cannot think of anything I wish to buy. Purchasing items unnecessarily would be a waste of money.
また今度、買い物をしに出掛ける機会があれば、\nそなたに付き合って貰いたいのだが: If the opportunity to go shopping arises another time, I would like you to accompany me... May I ask that of you?
ああ、オレで良ければ幾らでも付き合うさ。: Yeah, if you're fine with me, I'll tag along anytime.
タケルは普段、どのようなところを散策するのだ？\n私はこの街に来たことがまだ少な: Where do you usually explore, Takeru? I have not visited this town very often...
オレも本屋を見たり、ゲームを見たり……\nあとは純夏たちに連行されて、荷物持ちく: I mostly just browse bookstores, check out games... or get dragged around by Sumika and the others to carry their bags.
ああ、時折苦い顔をして連れていかれるタケルの姿を目撃したな。: Ah, yes. I have occasionally witnessed you being dragged along with a pained look on your face.
助けてくれよ……って、そういえば冥夜は服は買わないのか？\nいつも軍装ばっかりじ: Save me next time... Oh, speaking of which, Meiya, aren't you going to buy any clothes? Wearing military gear all the time must get stiff on your shoulders.
むう……タケルもそう思うか？\n鑑や珠瀬にも、オシャレをした方がよいと言われたの: Mmm... Do you think so as well, Takeru? Sumika and Tamase also told me that I should dress more fashionably.
ここまで困り事はなかったから、\n他の服は不要と断ったのだが……。: Since I faced no inconvenience thus far, I declined, stating that I had no need for other clothes...
そりゃ勿体ない。\n折角平和な世界なんだからオシャレしてもいいと思うぞ？: That's a real waste. Since we're in a peaceful world, there's no harm in dressing up a bit, right?
……た、タケルは私の私服姿を見たいのか？: ...D-Do you wish to see me in casual clothes, Takeru?
ああ、オシャレをした冥夜は見てみたいな。\nもしも買ったら一番に見せてくれるか？: Yeah, I'd love to see you dressed up. If you ever buy any, will you show me first?
ああ、勿論だ。\nであれば、また探してみるとしよう。: Yes, of course. In that case, I shall search for some another time.
（……なんだ、記憶探しって言ってたが……\n普通にデートしてるだけになってきたな: (...Wait, she said we were looking for memories... but this is just turning into a normal date.)
……しかし、今日はまだ何も思い出さないな。タケルはどうだ？: ...Still, I have recalled nothing today. What about you, Takeru?
ああいや、俺も考えてた。\n街を歩いてるだけじゃ、思い出せないな。: Ah, no, I was thinking about it too. Just walking through town isn't bringing anything back.
やはりそう簡単にはいかないか……。: So it is not so simple after all...
そうだな。まあ、街で歩いてるだけじゃ難しいか……\n他にも記憶に繋がりそうな場所: Yeah. Just walking around town might be tough... Wish there was somewhere else that could trigger a memory.
お、冥夜。何か見つけたのか？: Oh, Meiya. Did you find something?
ああ。この先に学校があるようだ。\n……一見すると、真っ当に見えるな。: Yes. There appears to be a school ahead. ...At first glance, it looks quite ordinary.
先日皆で訪れたスカラとは全く異なるな。: It is completely different from Scalar, which we visited the other day.
まあ、あそこが特殊だって話だったからな……\n折角だから、ちょっと見に行くか？: Well, Scalar was supposed to be a special case... Since we're here, wanna take a look inside?
うむ。街を歩くよりも良さそうだ。: Indeed. That sounds far more promising than walking aimlessly through town.
許可を取ってきたぞ。\n好きに見て回っていいってさ。: Got permission! They said we can look around as much as we like.
そなたに感謝を。それでは参ろうか。: My thanks to you. Shall we proceed, then?
……あの制服は桃園が着ていたものと同じだ。\nここは彼女が通っている校舎というわ: ...That uniform is the same as the one Momozono wore. So this is the school building she attends.
そうだな。もしかしたらどこかで出くわすかもな？: Yeah. Who knows, maybe we'll run into her somewhere.
ふふ、確かにな。\nだが鑑から羨ましがられるかもしれんな。: Fufu, indeed. Though Sumika might be envious of us.
……あー、確かにそうだな。\n俺たちだけで見学したってバレると面倒くさそうだ。: ...Ah, yeah, definitely. It's gonna be a pain if she finds out the two of us toured a school without her.
絶対に純夏の奴、ズルいからわたしも連れて行って！\nなんて駄々をこね始めるぞ。: Sumika will definitely throw a tantrum and say, 'That's not fair, take me with you too!'
はは、タケルの眉間にしわが寄る様が想像できるな。: Haha, I can easily picture the furrow in your brow, Takeru.
では、なるべく知り合いに見つからないように、\n静かに見学をさせてもらうか。: Then, to ensure we are not spotted by anyone we know, let us quietly tour the building.
ああ。それじゃあ中を見せてもらうか。: Yeah. Let's take a look inside.
……ふむ、生徒の数はそう多くないな。: ...Hmm, there are not many students about.
まあ、時間的に授業は終わってるだろうしな。\nそろそろ日暮れ時だし。: Well, classes are probably over by now given the hour. It's almost sundown, after all.
なるほど……しかし、不思議な気分だ。: I see... Yet, this is a strange feeling.
こうして、この校舎の廊下を歩いていると……\n記憶を思い出すわけではないが、懐か: Walking down the hallway of this school building... Though it does not spark any specific memory, it fills me with a sense of nostalgia.
郷愁だろうか……それとも、私も彼女たちのように、\n学生だった時があったのだろう: Is it homesickness... Or did I, too, have a time when I was a student, just like them...?
タケルはどうだ？ 懐かしさを感じはしないか？: What about you, Takeru? Do you not feel a sense of nostalgia?
そうだな……確かに、オレも懐かしい気持ちになるな。: Yeah... Now that you mention it, I feel nostalgic too.
もしかしたら、\n学校の廊下をこうして二人で並んで歩いたりしたのかもな？: Who knows, maybe the two of us used to walk side by side down school hallways like this before?
ふふ、確かにそうかもしれないな。\nタケルと二人の思い出か……: Fufu, perhaps that is so. Memories of just the two of us...
まあ、オレもしっかりとは思い出せてないんだけどな。: Well, it's not like I can clearly remember it either, though.
ああ、この教室……誰もいないのだなと思ってな。: Ah, this classroom... I was simply thinking about how empty it is.
そうだな。流石に帰ったんだろ。\n……って、冥夜？: Yeah. Everyone's probably gone home by now. ...Wait, Meiya?
（冥夜の奴……急に教室に入ってどうしたんだ？）: (Meiya... Why did she suddenly walk into the classroom?)
ここから見える景色は……まさに平和だな。: The view from here... is truly peaceful.
どうしたんだ冥夜？\nもしかして、何かを思い出したりしたのか？: What's wrong, Meiya? Did you happen to remember something?
いいや、そういうわけではない。\nただ……この景色をみていて思ったのだ: No, it is nothing like that. It is simply... looking at this scenery made me reflect.
私はこのような平和を知らない……\nだが、それを求めて戦っていた気がすると。: I do not know such peace... Yet, I feel as though I was fighting in pursuit of it.
そして、こうも思うのだ。\nこの世界は私達のいた世界とは全く違うのだろうと。: And I also find myself thinking... that this world must be completely different from the world we came from.
そう考えると……少しだけ、寂しくなったのだ。\n私がこの世界で思い出を作ったとし: When I consider that... I feel a slight wave of loneliness. Even if I forge memories in this world...
夢でもいいじゃないか: Even if it's a dream, isn't that fine?
楽しんでみたらいいんじゃないか？: Why not just try enjoying it?
元の世界で目を覚ましたときには忘れている……\n泡沫の夢でしかないのではないかと: I wonder if I will forget them upon waking in our original world... If all of this is merely a fleeting dream.
別に夢だとしてもいいんじゃないか？: Even if it's a dream, isn't that fine?
たとえ夢だったとしても……\n冥夜にとっては、望んでいた平和なんだろう？: Even if it's just a dream... to you, Meiya, isn't this the very peace you longed for?
なら、これはいつか平和な世界になったときのための、\n予行演習みたいなもんだと思: Then think of this as a dress rehearsal for when our world finally becomes peaceful one day.
なら、楽しんでみたらいいんじゃないか？: In that case, why not just try enjoying it?
タケル、私の話を聞いていたか？: Takeru, were you listening to what I said?
いや、寂しいだろうけど……そういう楽しかった記憶は、\nたとえ忘れても心のどこか: No, I get that it feels lonely... but happy memories like these, even if you forget them, will surely remain somewhere deep in your heart.
……心のどこかに残るはず……か。: ...Remain somewhere deep in my heart... is it?
ああ。だから今のうちに沢山楽しい記憶を作ればいい。\nそんで、それを実現しようっ: Yeah. So for now, just make as many happy memories as you can. Then, use them as emotional support to make that peaceful future a reality.
……ふふ、そなたにそう言われると、\n不思議と自分の悩みが小さく思えてしまうな。: ...Fufu, hearing you say that makes my worries feel strangely insignificant.
いや、そんなことはないだろ。\n冥夜の気持ちもわかるぞ？: No, that's not true at all. I understand how you feel, Meiya.
異世界だの、メイズだの……夢だって言われても、\n納得するくらいに突拍子のない話: Parallel worlds, Mazes... All of this is so absurd that if someone told me it was a dream, I'd probably believe them.
ふふ、確かにそれはそうだな。\n下手な夢より現実味がなく……優しくて幸せな夢だ。: Fufu, indeed that is true. It feels less real than a poorly constructed dream... A gentle, happy dream.
まあ、夢っていうにはいささか現実感が強すぎるけどな。: Though calling it a dream feels a bit much when it feels this vivid.
はは、確かにそれはそうだ。\nそうだな、私は難しく考えすぎていたのかもしれないな: Haha, indeed it does. You are right, perhaps I was overcomplicating things.
ああ。いつか戻るための手段を探して……\nで、それまではここで楽しい記憶を作って: Yeah. We'll search for a way back someday... and until then, we just create happy memories here.
そうだな……折角なら、生徒会長にでも頼んで、\nどこかの学校の学生として通うのも: That's it... Since we're here, why not ask the Student Council President to let us attend one of the schools as students?
ああ。純夏とか委員長とか、たまとかも一緒にな。: Yeah. Together with Sumika, Class Rep, Tama, and the rest.
全員で朝起きて学校に通って授業を受ける。\nで、学校が終わったらくだらないことを: We'd all wake up in the morning, go to school, and take classes. Then, after school, we'd talk about silly things on our way home.
しかし、流石に他の生徒から悪目立ちしないだろうか？: However, would we not stand out far too much to the other students?
それならその時だろ。\nそれだって楽しい記憶になるさ。: We can worry about that when the time comes. Even that would become a fun memory.
全く……そなたは何時如何なるときもそなたなのだな。: Honestly... No matter the time or place, you are always true to yourself.
そなたに感謝を。タケル。\nおかげで……少しだけ心の整理が出来た。: My gratitude to you, Takeru. Thanks to you... I have managed to sort out my feelings a little.
きっと、怖かったのだ。\n平和で優しいこの世界にいることが……: Deep down, I believe I was afraid. Afraid of being in this peaceful, gentle world...
冥夜は普段から気を張ってるからな。\nその落差で気持ちが追い付いてないだけさ。: You're always so tense normally. The sharp contrast just made it hard for your feelings to catch up.
だが、そなたの言う通り……私達の世界では失われた平和な日常を、\n今だけは楽しん: Yet, as you say... perhaps it is acceptable for us to enjoy this peaceful everyday life that was lost in our own world, if only for now.
ああ、そんで元の世界に戻れたら作ってやろうぜ。\nこの世界にも負けないくらい平和: Yeah. And once we get back to our original world, let's build one ourselves—a world every bit as peaceful as this one.
ああ……必ず、平和な世界を取り戻そう。\nタケルや皆と一緒に……: Yes... We shall surely reclaim a peaceful world. Together with you, Takeru, and everyone else...
